name: Mamono Musume to no Seikatsu ~Lamia no Baai~
original_name: 魔物娘との性活～ラミアの場合～
source:
Years ago, Light made a promise with his childhood crush, swearing that they would one day meet again to get married. Now, years later, he is surprised to find her standing on his doorstep! She's ready to pick back up where they left of, but there's a problem... she isn't quite what he remembered.

She a stubborn tsundere lamia named Leimia, who is has arrived to bring her husband-to-be back to her tribe. Light isn't sure how to react to a lamia at his doorstep, let along one who wants to marry him. Light refuses her invitations, but Leimia won't give up that easy! She decides the best way to convince him is to move in with him. Not only that, she is determined to make him fall for her, and will do whatever she can to achieve that!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210203111743/https://jastusa.com/2019/mamono-musume-life-with-a-lamia-coming-summer-of-2019]Jast USA[/url]]
translation:
多年前，莱特与青梅竹马的心上人立下约定，发誓将来一定会重逢并结婚。数年后的今天，他惊讶地发现她竟站在自家门口！她已经准备好延续当年的约定，可有一个问题…她和莱特记忆中的模样不太一样。

她名叫蕾米娅，是个顽固又傲娇的拉米亚，此行是为了把未来的丈夫带回自己的部落。面对突然出现在家门口的拉米亚，莱特不知该如何反应，更别提对方还想嫁给他。莱特拒绝了她的邀请，蕾米娅却不会轻易放弃！她认定说服他的最好方法就是搬来同住。不仅如此，她还决心让莱特爱上自己，并愿意为达目的尝试一切办法！

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210203111743/https://jastusa.com/2019/mamono-musume-life-with-a-lamia-coming-summer-of-2019]Jast USA[/url]]
